name: Palmistry
supported: Manual JSON observations for one/two explicitly identified hands; strict enums,unknown/uncertain values and no inferred features
Life/Head/Heart presence and morphology recorded; selected source-supported relation,curvature,branch,origin and continuity interpretations
Six qualitative source-defined hand types and eight fixed mount positions; ordinary developed-mount symbolic components
Recorded dominance with literal Cheiro right/acquired,left/natural context; no automatic dominant-hand reversal
Millimeter proportions and descriptive ratios only; no invented shape thresholds
37 source-located versioned rules,diagnostic trace,source exceptions and non-averaged symbolic tensions
Contradictory observations suppress affected interpretations; unsupported observations and markings stay explicit
Offline JSON/Markdown CLI and source-linked observation guide; no image loading or retention
experimental: Subjective observer classification accuracy is unmeasured; published tests check symbolic rule selection,not real-hand feature recognition
Mixed-hand and sloping-Head context is qualified,not a complete whole-hand synthesis
Author side-use assumptions retained as historical convention,not contemporary evidence
unsupported: Benham and Saint-Germain reading profiles; sources retained in original rank order
Elementary type,finger/shape subtypes,mount excess or leaning,minor markings and timing scales
Empirical personality inference,compatibility percentages,success guarantees or outcome probabilities

configuration_matrix.input: schema_version1; exact profile; one/two unique left/right hands; omissions unknown
configuration_matrix.line_observation_fields: knowledge/palmistry_input_reference_v1.json; only fully matched source conditions interpreted
configuration_matrix.source_side_protocol: pp77-78; left natural/inherited,right acquired/training; left-handed observation does not authorize a flip
configuration_matrix.interpretations: Direct concise source summaries; symbolic tensions are explicitly compositional presentation aids; unmatched combinations unsupported
configuration_matrix.depth_length_continuity: Recorded for all three lines; only selected nonmedical interpretations implemented. Life length/depth/breaks never yield health/longevity readings

acceptance.limits: Six transcribed published types/schematic details,not complete-person readings or empirical validation; sample input is constructed usage data.

P1: More independently inspected Benham original and Saint-Germain procedures under separate profiles
Further source-verified line/shape/mount exceptions and hand-context combinations
Assisted image extraction only after consent,orientation checks,independent landmark accuracy and user correction are established
P2: Indian Samudrika original-source review and dermatoglyphics as separate traditions
Extensive minor marks,timing scales and obscure shape variations
Advanced vision pipelines only after practical independently validated feasibility
licensing: No new runtime dependency. Original Cheiro scan/page images remain unbundled research references; Commons public-domain attribution and actual Ninth Edition title/copyright retained. No modern reprint corpus or photo collection ingested; pip check clean. Existing source/local distribution limitations unchanged.
meaning: Bounded Western symbolic manual-reading product meets acceptance; not exhaustive palmistry or evidence of personality,medical conditions,longevity or scientifically validated prediction.
next: After this closure is committed/pushed,identify Technique9 in the original inventory and audit resources only.
